content.text:
BIS Hanoi (British International School Hanoi, part of Nord Anglia Education) admits pupils through a short enquiry, application, assessment and offer process. For 2026–27, yearly tuition runs from about VND 343 million for the youngest pupils to about VND 970 million for Years 12–13.

## Admission process

**Who can apply:**
BIS Hanoi is an independent, co-educational day school. It offers places all year round to children aged 2 to 18, from all backgrounds and nationalities.
The school says it is
a selective school, and every child must show the skills and knowledge to follow its curriculum. English is the language used in classes and around the school.

**Steps:**
1. **Send an enquiry.** You fill in the online enquiry form, and the school
will reply within 24 hours (local time, Monday to Friday).
2. **Visit.** You can tour the campus in Hanoi or
take a virtual campus tour.
3. **Apply.** You complete the online application and upload supporting documents. These include

a signed copy of the Admissions Terms and Conditions, the child's latest school records in English (translated if needed), any learning support assessment documents, a digital passport-style photo, a copy of the passport or birth certificate, and medical and immunisation records.
4. **Assessment and interview.**
The child is invited to an assessment and interview with the Head of Primary or Secondary.
For Early Years children (Foundation 1–3), this is a
class observation

.
5. **Accept the offer.**
You pay the Registration Fee when you accept a place. It is paid only once and guarantees the place, which is not confirmed until the fee is paid.
The school is currently advertising
admissions open for 2026/27, with limited spaces in certain year groups.

## Fees (2026–27, in VND)

**One-off fees:**
- **Application fee:**
4,500,000 VND per child, non-refundable, paid when you submit the online form and documents.
- **Registration fee:**
non-refundable; VND 23,600,000 for the Foundation Stage or VND 70,800,000 for Primary and Secondary, paid when you accept the offer.
- **Security deposit:** a third-party fee site lists a
refundable security deposit of 23,600,000 ₫

(based on 2025/26 fees). Check with the school whether it still applies.

**Annual tuition:**
- The range runs from about **VND 343.1 million** for the youngest Early Years group to **VND 970.2 million** for Year 12–13. These figures come from a fee-listing site, Edarabia, and its top figure matches the official schedule.
- The school's official schedule shows, for example,
Year 7 at VND 846,800,000 and Year 12 at VND 970,200,000 per year.

For other year groups, use the official Schedule of Fees PDF, because third-party sites list them inconsistently.
- **What tuition covers:**

uniforms, daily lunches, snacks (Early Years and Primary), learning materials and equipment, day trips, required international exams for Secondary students, and after-school activities run by school staff.

**Payment terms:**
-

Fees are paid in advance, and parents choose one of two payment plans before 31 July 2026. Paying for the whole year costs less than paying by term, but the full annual fee must be paid before 31 July 2026.
- Term payments are
due by 31 July 2026 (Term 1), 18 December 2026 (Term 2) and 16 April 2027 (Term 3).
Fees still unpaid on 31 July 2026 lose any discount, and fees unpaid after the due date incur a late fee of 1.5% per month.
A 10% family discount applies to the third and any later children in a family with three or more enrolled.

- Extra fees can apply for English as an Additional Language (EAL) support.

Some third-party sites (for example, ones quoting USD 18,000–28,000 or a VND 3.5 million application fee) show outdated or inaccurate figures. Use the school's official tuition-fees page and Schedule of Fees PDF. For questions, the admissions team is on
